full_selected_draft_diff.after: 设 $L=3a(a+6)$，$R=(3a+6)\times(a+4)$。分别比较 $a=-5,\ 0,\ 40$ 时的值，并判断对任意实数 $a$ 两式的大小关系。以下哪项差值计算及其结论正确？

full_selected_draft_diff.after: $4(2+a)-[3(a+1)+a]=5>0$，所以第一对的左式对所有 $a$ 都小于右式。

after.derivation: Enumerate by first coordinate: 3 divides 3,6,24; 6 divides 6,24; 7 divides only 7 in X; 24 divides only 24 in X. These are all seven listed pairs. In particular both (3,6) and (6,24) occur, together with (3,24) and every self-loop; there are no further divisible pairs.

Wrong steps: enumerate the correct seven pairs but reverse the endpoints of the 6->24 arrow when converting that arrow to an ordered pair. Replace (6,24) by (24,6), preserving all six other pairs. The result both omits the required incidence witnessed by 24=4*6 and inserts a false one, since 6/24=1/4 is not an integer.
after.misconception: Reversing one factor-to-multiple arrow while converting a complete relation into ordered pairs preserves its pair count but changes its meaning.
